'''Wipolo Nagg''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who hailed from [[Batuu]]. He was recruited into the [[Resistance]], and helped clear out the [[jungle]] around the Resistance [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]]. While he was part of the support crew, Nagg was allowed to join a [[Exegol landing team|ground team]] in preparation for the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
